offers_products.reason: Sells instruments, reagents, assays, antibodies, imaging systems, software and diagnostic tests such as T-SPOT.TB.

offers_services.reason: Offers contract research, functional genomic screening, viral vector manufacturing and clinical genetic testing services, though secondary to products.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Buyers are labs, pharma, biotech, CROs, hospitals and diagnostic labs, not households.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Sells to pharma, biotech, academia, CROs, CDMOs, diagnostic labs and newborn screening programs.

recurring_revenue.reason: Most revenue is repeat reagents, assays, consumables and diagnostic test kits, plus service contracts, rather than one-off instruments.

cyclical_demand.reason: Diagnostics and screening tests are steady; research reagents are less discretionary, though biotech funding can soften instrument demand.

big_ticket.reason: Mostly frequent purchases of reagents, kits and consumables; instruments like Opera Phenix are larger but a minority.

people_delivered.reason: Customers mainly pay for manufactured reagents, instruments, software and test kits, not staff time.

large_customers.reason: Customers include top pharma companies, large CROs and CDMOs, and public health newborn screening programs.

asset_heavy.reason: Life science tools maker with manufacturing and R&D, but not heavy plants, fleets or networks.

notes: Mix of life science research tools and diagnostics; the products side is the larger part.
